hunt.json.format: Array of per-game objects; Q1 and reference groups are disjoint.
hunt.json.closest_short: Minimum reachable path distance over all reconstructed states while their queen is alive, entire game; null if no reachable short dragon in any such state.
hunt.json.closest_short_window: Same minimum restricted to round >100, our queen dead, their queen alive.
hunt.json.adjacent_steps: Successful moves by our heads onto an open-edge or portal neighbour of their living queen; entire game.
hunt.json.adjacent_short_steps: Subset of adjacent_steps where the moving dragon had length <=4 immediately before that step.
hunt.json.adjacent_steps_window: Subset of adjacent_steps in the round >100 / our queen dead window.
hunt.json.adjacent_short_steps_window: Subset of adjacent_short_steps in that window.
hunt.json.queen_death: Their queen's death, or null when she survives. length is hers; other_length is collision partner's length, or null if no other dragon was involved. queen_lengths_before records both queen lengths before this death event. Head-on partners die simultaneously despite event serialization.
hunt.json.our_queen_death: Our queen's death object in the same format.

growth.json.format: Array of per-game objects; never_grew or grew, using only shared layouts.
growth.json.no_meal: Counts over all our no-meal turns in rounds 0..100 inclusive. Missing counter keys mean zero. known_unreachable means at least one remembered pearl but no remembered pearl is reachable. gt15 excludes unreachable here; the summary combines both and also gives the unreachable subset.
growth.json.net_centre_reduce: No-meal turns where the last successful step position is closer to the centre than the turn-start position; extra metric separate from the requested first-step metric.
growth.json.alive_end_round100: End-of-round-100 population; zero if we were eliminated before round 100.
growth.json.first_meal_round: Our first pearl consumption over the entire replay; null if none.
growth.json.first_split_round: Our first dragonSplit event over the entire replay; null if none.
growth.json.pearls_through50: Actual consumption counts, natural pearls and death drops, rounds 0..50 inclusive, separately for us and them.

aggregate.json: Raw denominators and totals underlying summary.md; null distances are split into no_short and unreachable in mid_age_distances.
validation.json: All main games, including those outside the comparison groups; reconstructed alive/total/longest/queen_length for both sides and winner compared to rows.jsonl.
